Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.label: Wiesel
Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.description:
A lightly armored fighting vehicle, the Wiesel is a light tank capable of reconnaisance. Small cargo capacity along with two crew capacity, all-terrain capability, the main downside is that it's not as potent as a general light tank in combat.

The Wiesel has good fuel efficiency and is quite low-profile along with its high maneuverability and speed covers for its lack of raw fire power.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel type:</color> Chemfuel
